final: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS number_of_orders FROM "order" AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), differences AS (SELECT account_id, region, number_of_orders, number_of_orders - AVG(number_of_orders) OVER () AS difference_from_overall_average FROM order_counts), regional AS (SELECT account_id, region, number_of_orders, difference_from_overall_average, difference_from_overall_average - AVG(difference_from_overall_average) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS excess_over_region_average FROM differences) SELECT account_id, region, number_of_orders, difference_from_overall_average, excess_over_region_average FROM regional WHERE excess_over_region_average > 0 ORDER BY excess_over_region_average DESC LIMIT 10
